title: Cambridge IELTS 19 Test 3 Writing Task 2
directions: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
prompt: It is important for everyone, including young people, to save money for their future.
scenario: It is important for everyone, including young people, to save money for their future.
requirements: To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
